text_block_list.text:
With her outstanding physical abilities,

Марузенски has attracted so much
attention that
fans start calling her Hot
Rod even before her
debut.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Adored as a role model by the younger
students,
she sets her sights on the
greatest of events.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Марузенски now aims to take on the
Twinkle
Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
